usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Main Indicators: USD/KWD exchange rate
usdRate.note: 0.30820/0.30830 dinar per US dollar (bid/ask) on 29 October 2026; the dinar is pegged to an undisclosed basket. World Bank 2025 average 0.3065. CLDR gives no narrow symbol; 'KD' is the usual local abbreviation.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing the Central Statistical Bureau, CPI July 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 2.19% year on year in July 2026 (2.19% in June); secondary source because the CSB release was not read. World Bank 2025 average 2.36%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: World Bank CPI inflation 2021-2025 (about 3% average, 2.4% in 2025); latest 2.19% (July 2026); dinar pegged to a currency basket
inflation_projection.note: Inflation has eased from 4% in 2022 to about 2.2-2.4%, with the dinar pegged to an undisclosed basket, so 2.5% a year is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Main Indicators: discount rate
policy_rate.note: Discount rate 3.50% (last changed 11 December 2025); overnight repo 3.125%, 1-week 3.375%, 1-month 3.625%.

savings_account_rate.note: The CBK publishes counter rates on time deposits only; no average rate for savings accounts was found.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026, Table 20 (average counter interest rates on customer KD time deposits, 3 months)
fdr_3m_rate.note: 3.294% on 3-month KD time deposits in September 2026; simple average of daily counter rates for KD 25,000-50,000 deposits at conventional banks (Islamic banks excluded).

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026, Table 20 (average counter interest rates on customer KD time deposits, 12 months)
fdr_1y_rate.note: 3.602% on 12-month KD time deposits in September 2026; KD 25,000-50,000 deposits at conventional banks.

dps_rate.note: No industry-wide rate for a monthly recurring deposit product was found in the CBK statistics.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026, Table 16 (private-sector KD deposits by interest rate, weighted interest rate)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted interest rate on all private-sector KD deposits at local banks, 2.57% in September 2026, including the 24% that pay no interest.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; treasury bonds and CBK bonds are sold to banks.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026, Table 8-1 (CBK bonds and related tawarruq, 3-month rate)
tbill_91d_rate.note: Rate on 3-month CBK bonds (a monetary instrument sold to banks) 3.625% since December 2025; no 3-month treasury bills are issued and no 3-month CBK bonds were outstanding in September 2026.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026, Table 8 (public debt instruments, interest rate on new issues, 5 years)
tbond_5y_rate.note: 5-year treasury bonds issued in August 2026 at 3.375% (3.25% in June and July 2026); public debt issuance resumed in 2025.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026, Table 8 (public debt instruments, interest rate on new issues, 10 years)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Latest 10-year issue was in October 2025 at 5.125%, before rates fell; a 7-year bond was issued at 3.625% in September 2026, so the current 10-year yield is likely lower.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Kuwait, taxes on personal income
tax_bank_interest.note: There is no personal income tax in Kuwait, so bank interest is untaxed for individuals.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Kuwait, taxes on personal income
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No personal income tax, so returns on government securities are untaxed for individuals (no retail savings certificate exists).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Deposits at local banks are guaranteed by the state under Law No. 30 of 2008, but no current CBK page stating the guarantee or a limit was read, so it is not recorded.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: The CBK caps consumer lending rates relative to the discount rate, but no current official page with the credit card rate or cap was read.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Boursa Kuwait All Share index via Trading Economics (down 6.4% in the year to October 2026)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: below the deposit rate, as in weak years for the oil-linked market.

equity_return_base.sourceName: CBK 3-month deposit rate 3.29% (untaxed); Boursa Kuwait record (Trading Economics)
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3 points above the untaxed deposit rate, within the 4-point cap, because the market has had a moderate, dividend-driven record.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Boursa Kuwait All Share index via Trading Economics
equity_return_high.note: High case: a fuller equity premium, as in strong oil-price years.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, USD/KWD 0.3082 (29 October 2026); dinar pegged to a basket
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold and a stable dinar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait exchange rate; long-run dollar gold trend
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year; the basket peg keeps the dinar close to the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait exchange rate; long-run dollar gold trend
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold years.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026 (deposit rates)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates fall further if the discount rate is cut, untaxed.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026, Table 20 (3-month KD deposit 3.29%)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: the untaxed 3-month KD deposit rate; government bonds are sold to banks, not to individuals.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026 (12-month deposit 3.60%; CBK 12-month bonds 3.875%)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer deposits or funds holding government bonds.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Insurance Regulatory Unit publishes no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold, but no regulator or other public table of premiums per KD 1,000 of cover by age was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No public table of private health insurance premiums by age was found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Kuwait
oop_health_share.note: 10.0% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Trading Economics, Kuwait CPI health index 127.5 in July 2026 (2013=100), about 1.8% a year since 2013
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices have risen about 1.8% a year since 2013, a little below general inflation, but private care usually costs more over time, so 0.5 points above the 2.5% assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Trading Economics, Kuwait CPI education index 128.9 in July 2026 (2013=100), about 1.9% a year since 2013
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices have risen about 1.9% a year since 2013; private school fees rise faster, so 0.5 points above the 2.5% assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net, life expectancy at birth, Kuwait, 2026
life_expectancy.note: 81.0 years (men 79.8, women 82.3), UN WPP 2024 medium variant; secondary source. The World Bank (SP.DYN.LE00.IN) gives 84.6 for 2024.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 4.03 (2025, World Bank), 6.6 (2040) and 9.2 (2065, populationpyramid.net/kuwait/2065/); the large young migrant workforce keeps the ratio very high.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Public Institution for Social Security (PIFSS), Insurance guide (دليل التأمينات), edition 10
retirement_age_default.note: Legal retirement age 55 for civilian men and 50 for civilian women (Kuwaiti nationals), with full pension after 30 years of service and a 15-year minimum; the guide dates from January 2023 (older than 2025) and later amendments could not be checked.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Public Institution for Social Security (PIFSS), Insurance guide (دليل التأمينات), edition 10
retirement_age_government.note: Kuwaiti civil servants are insured with PIFSS under the same civilian rules: 55 for men, 50 for women (military 45); the guide dates from January 2023.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026 (deposit rates)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: lower deposit rates after future rate cuts.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026, Table 20 (3-month KD deposit 3.29%; 12-month 3.60%)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: the untaxed 3-month deposit rate, below the 1-year deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026 (12-month deposit 3.60%)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: longer deposits and bond funds.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026 (deposits and government bonds)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about the deposit rate.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026; equity base 6.5%; gold base 4%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits, Gulf equities and some gold.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Kuwait, Monthly Monetary Statistical Bulletin, September 2026; equity high 9%

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Older Kuwaitis on low incomes can get means-tested social assistance from the Ministry of Social Affairs, but no current amount for an older person could be read from an official source; non-Kuwaitis are not covered.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Eligibility rules for social assistance to older people could not be read from an official source.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Kuwait, individual other taxes (terminal indemnity under the Kuwait Labour Law)
gratuity_rule.note: Per PwC: workers who complete three years with an employer get 15 days' pay per year for the first three years and two-thirds of a month's pay (20 of 30 days) per year after that. Mainly relevant to expatriates, who are outside social security; the Labour Law text itself was not read.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Public Institution for Social Security (PIFSS), Insurance guide (دليل التأمينات), edition 10; PwC Kuwait (no personal income tax)
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory social insurance for Kuwaiti nationals in government and private jobs (employee 10.5%, employer 11.5% per PwC); pension from 55 for men and 50 for women with 15+ years (best rate at 30 years); increases come from a separate pension-increase fund, not CPI indexation. Guide dated January 2023; non-Kuwaitis are not covered.

savings_account.note: Savings accounts pay little; many offer prize draws instead of interest.

fdr_3m.note: Average counter rate 3.29% for KD deposits in September 2026.

fdr_1y.note: Average counter rate 3.60% for KD deposits in September 2026.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: No treasury bills are issued; the CBK's own 3-month bonds and tawarruq are sold only to banks.

tbond_5y.note: Issued through the CBK since 2025 and bought by local banks.

tbond_10y.note: Issued through the CBK and bought by local banks.

equity_fund.note: Local equity funds investing on Boursa Kuwait are available.

gold.note: Gold bars, coins and jewellery are freely sold.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (public health care for citizens)
